name: FinanceBIAskQuestion
description: Answers a natural-language question about BI dashboard data for one organization unit, forwarding it to the BI API's ask endpoint. Tile mode (ComponentIDs supplied) grounds the answer in specific dashboard tiles; general mode (no ComponentIDs) answers over every metric type available for the OU/timeframe.
auth_description: Requires a user of type `Employee` or `Api`

headers.name: EVA-User-Agent
headers.description: The user agent that is making these calls. Don't make this specific per device/browser but per application. This should be of the form: `MyFirstUserAgent/1.0.0`

headers.name: EVA-Requested-OrganizationUnitID
headers.description: The ID of the organization unit to run this request in.

headers.name: EVA-Requested-OrganizationUnit-Query
headers.description: The query that selects the organization unit to run this request in.

headers.name: EVA-IDs-Mode
headers.description: The IDs mode to run this request in. Currently only `ExternalIDs` is supported.

B.name: AdditionalContext
B.description:
Free-text background the tiles alone don't carry, forwarded to the model.

This string must be between 0 (incl) and 4000 (incl) characters long.

B.name: ComponentIDs
B.description:
The BI dashboard components (tiles) the answer should be grounded in. Null or empty asks in general mode over every answerable metric type for the OU/timeframe. At most 20.

This is the ID of a `BIDashboardComponent`

B.name: IncludeServiceData
B.description: Whether to include the per-tile service data in the response. Defaults to true; set false for a follow-up chat turn where the caller already has the tile data.

B.name: OrganizationUnitID
B.description:
The organization unit to ask about. Requires the BIDashboardViewData functionality in this organization unit.

This is the ID of a `OrganizationUnit`

B.name: Question
B.description:
The natural-language question to answer.

This string must be between 1 (incl) and 1000 (incl) characters long.

D.name: Code
D.description: A unique ID identifying this error.

D.name: Message
D.description: A human-readable message describing the error.

D.name: RequestID
D.description: A unique ID identifying the request. Please provide this ID when contacting support.

D.name: Type
D.description: A short description of the error type.

E.name: ExternalIDs
E.description: When using the `ExternalIDs` mode, this will hold the resolved external IDs.

E.name: IsAsyncResultAvailable
E.description: This is a flag indicating whether the async request is done. If it is `null`, it is not an async service. If it is `false`, the response is not yet available. Do not process the properties in that case. It is is `true` the properties are filled with the result of the call.

E.name: UnresolvedExternalIDs
E.description: When using the `ExternalIDs` mode, this will hold the external IDs we couldn't resolve.

F.name: ComponentID
F.description:
The EVA component this tile is for. Null in general mode, where no registered component exists.

This is the ID of a `BIDashboardComponent`

F.name: ComponentType
F.description:
The tile's metric type. Null when the BI API reports a type this EVA version does not know yet.
Possible values:

* `1` - ConsumersOnboarded
* `2` - Revenue
* `3` - AverageOrderValue
* `4` - AverageProductsPerBasket
* `5` - TotalTransactions
* `6` - MobileSalesPercentage
* `7` - HeroProducts
* `8` - OverdueTasks
* `9` - SFSExecutionTime
* `10` - IdentifiedSales
* `11` - Custom

F.name: Included
F.description: Whether this tile actually grounded the answer. False for tiles the BI API could not resolve.

F.name: Status
F.description:
Possible values:

* `0` - Ok
* `1` - Materializing
* `2` - SpecInvalid
* `3` - Unsupported

F.name: Unit
F.description:
Possible values:

* `0` - Unknown
* `1` - Currency
* `2` - Count
* `3` - Ratio
* `4` - Percentage
* `5` - Seconds

F.name: Value
F.description: The tile's rendered value, when the BI API includes one.

C.name: Model
C.description: The model that produced the answer.

C.name: Tiles
C.description: The tiles that grounded the answer, in the order returned by the BI API. Omitted when IncludeServiceData is false.
